title: Bitcoin falls to $82,000 as OpenAI revenue concerns and geopolitical tensions trigger nearly $1 billion in crypto liquidations

Ethereum and major altcoins also declined, while analysts flagged $80,000 as a key Bitcoin support level amid elevated Treasury yields and continued market volatility.

title: India bonds extend weekly slide; struggle to shake off RBI hike, hawkish stance shift
description: Indian government bonds have faced a downturn for the eighth consecutive week, primarily influenced by soaring oil prices and a more aggressive stance from the central bank. The yield on benchmark bonds has surged, signaling a drop in investor confidence. Additionally, the Reserve Bank of India raised the repo rate to 5.50%, with economists anticipating further increments that may take it to at least 6.00%.

title: Reissued bonds account for nearly 66% of state borrowings in H1 FY27: Report
description: In recent years, states have made a substantial impact on their finances by reissuing bonds, which now form a significant portion of their market borrowings. This trend, particularly pronounced over the last two years, illustrates an increased involvement from state governments. Coupled with the Reserve Bank of India's push for greater market transparency, the reissuance of bonds could enhance liquidity, creating a more appealing landscape for bond investors.

title: Market wrap: ITC, TCS, BSE, RIL top gainers and losers on Nifty and Sensex on Friday
description: The Indian equity markets saw a robust recovery as both the BSE Sensex and Nifty 50 registered remarkable gains. The Nifty 50 surged by 288.65 points, closing at 22,520.45, while the Sensex jumped 879.09 points. Notably, the Nifty IT index rose 3%, signaling a positive market sentiment. A total of 2,182 out of 3,684 stocks climbed higher, reflecting renewed investor interest in bargain opportunities.

title: Airtel Money makes London Stock Exchange debut
description: Airtel Money has made its debut on the London Stock Exchange after a significant IPO process. The offer price was set at £1.96 per share, with trading beginning conditionally. Initial trading reflected a slight increase as shares were valued at about £2.00 before easing. Bharti Airtel holds a significant stake in Airtel Money through Airtel Africa. Unconditional trading is expected to start on October 14, 2026.
